title: Branch-sensitive equivalence of dynamic circuits
difficulty_explanation: Branch-resolved instrument equivalence requires preserving unnormalized conditional maps, reset semantics, and feed-forward across hidden probes; averaged output-state comparisons are insufficient.

seed_protocol.base_seed_mapping: The single base seed initializes one NumPy Generator stream that deterministically emits all 12 ordered hidden cases.
seed_protocol.determinism_scope: Exact public case bytes are deterministic under the pinned runtime and are identified by the evaluator-emitted case_digest.
seed_protocol.case_identity: SHA-256 of canonical JSON with sorted keys and compact separators over the ordered exact public cases; functional stdout emits the full case_digest and protocol_seed in one structured orbit_q_case_identity JSON line.
seed_protocol.pinned_numpy_note: The target image pins NumPy 2.2.6; a seed alone is not a cross-runtime case identity, so trial manifests must bind the image/runtime and case_digest.

contract.hidden_case_source: explicit evaluator --seed, otherwise verifier-only ORBIT_Q_CANDIDATE_SEED, legacy ORBIT_DYNAMIC_SEED, or local default 1032026
contract.determinism_scope: one base seed drives the ordered 12-case generator stream; trial evidence binds the pinned image and evaluator-emitted case_digest
contract.anti_hardcoding: The seed changes program syntax, probes, mutations, and case digest; labels are not passed to the solution.
contract.oracle: Independent complex128 NumPy branch projector simulation

difficulty_levers: syntactically distant but exactly equivalent circuit identities
planted angle, feed-forward, and reset mutations
claim_boundary: The expert and evaluator are validated prototypes. No solver-model trial has been run and no model-hardness claim is made.
api_risks: TensorCircuit post_select returns an unnormalized state; normalizing would erase branch probability.
post_select is an alias of the mid_measurement projector path in the pinned image and should be canaried after upgrades.
The pinned projector path showed approximately 1e-6 accumulated normalization error on rewritten circuits, so the evaluator uses a 5e-6 equivalence tolerance while planted mutations exceed 2e-4.
Circuit-wide backend and dtype setters are process-global, so evaluator isolation is required when mixing framework tests.
